text:
natalie: heads up — we're seeing a SCIM provisioning loop for a subset of users coming from Okta. users get created, then shortly deprovisioned, then re-provisioned. happens only for identities with uncommon unicode in externalId (emoji / null bytes?)

sam: ugh. any logs? is this hitting KMS decrypt errors or a validation step?

natalie: logs show `scim_provisioner: failed to unwrap ext_id: invalid utf-8` and then `kms: decrypt failed: malformed payload` right after. stack: provisioner -> id-mapper -> kms-client. pasted snippet below:

natalie: ```
2026-03-20T15:11:02Z ERROR scim_provisioner handler.go:129 failed to normalize externalId: "user:\u0000john"
2026-03-20T15:11:02Z WARN kms-client client.go:78 decrypt failed: ciphertext malformed
2026-03-20T15:11:02Z INFO scim_provisioner handler.go:140 scheduling deprovision for user id 1234
```

jeff: looks like two separate issues: 1) upstream id contains NUL/invalid utf8, 2) KMS unwrap chokes on that payload after base64. Could be our envelope encoding rejects NUL bytes.

anna: quick check — are these users coming from an IdP that does any normalization? which Okta pipeline?

natalie: Okta org: acme-prod, mapping uses `user.externalId` -> SCIM `externalId`. We recently rolled a transform that prepends tenant prefix for some SSO flows. suspect the transform touched binary bytes.

sam: can you grep for the mapping change? maybe a bad concat with a binary blob (SAML NameID raw bytes).

natalie: yeah found config change on 2026-03-19 22:03 by @ops-batch: `externalId = tenant + ":" + raw.nameid` — raw.nameid sometimes contains weird chars.

security-bot: noted: creating alert SEC-2026-03-01 — SCIM externalId normalization failure cluster. tag: kms, scim, okta.

jeff: mitigation ideas: 1) quick fix — add a safe-normalize step that drops non-printable/control chars before KMS envelope creation, 2) longer fix — upstream mapping must base64-encode raw blobs or use url-safe encoding.

anna: agree. we should avoid mutating the envelope after KMS. If the mapping writes the externalId with raw NUL into the material that gets encrypted, unwrap will fail deterministically.

sam: temporary rollback of the mapping? can we revert the change in Okta pipeline?

natalie: I can roll back mapping in prod Okta now but worried about churn for existing tenants that rely on tenant prefix. alternative is to gate the transform: apply only when nameid matches `^[\p{Print}[:space:]]+$` else base64-encode.

jeff: also need to handle already-broken accounts in our DB. For those, deprovision loop will keep flipping. We should add a backoff: if we see repeated decrypt errors for same extID, mark as `needs-manual-review` and stop automatic re-provisioning to avoid noise.

sam: good call. can we add that label quickly? where is the deprov loop controller? eng-identity service has the backoff flag — PR would be small.

natalie: I'll open a tiny PR to check decrypt errors and flip a `manual_review=true` and postmortem tag. will also attach a retro ticket for migration of affected accounts.

anna: for the rollback path: coordinate with @platform-ops to patch the Okta mapping and schedule a 5m maintenance window. we should also notify CS for noisy account churn.

security-bot: recommended playbook step: rotate KMS envelope keys? not necessary yet — this looks data-format only. keep on watchlist.

jeff: tests to add: unit for normalization step, e2e that runs sample nameids containing emoji and null bytes to ensure base64 path, and an SLO check that deprovision churn doesn't exceed baseline.

sam: can someone own rollout? I'll take coordination with platform-ops and CS notices.

natalie: I'll do the PR for the `manual_review` short-circuit and add the normalization guard. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eng-identity/pull/482

natalie: also, quick fix command if you need to mute a user from the reconcile loop (run on prod db):

natalie: ```sql
UPDATE users SET reconcile_paused = true, note = 'paused: scim extid invalid utf8, SEC-2026-03-01' WHERE id IN (1234, 1256, 1299);
```

jeff: 👍 once PR is merged I'll deploy the backoff and we can coordinate the Okta mapping rollback 30m after.

sam: thanks team. I'll post an incident summary to #incidents and ping CS. keep thread updated with PR and rollback status.

natalie: will do. leaving logs attached in the ticket. thanks :heart:
